summary: PR #1256 (cloud/lane-resume-adoption-exclusive) was built in the cloud window on 2026-11-03/04 and fell 400+ commits behind main. It was closed unmerged. Its description: ## Summary Closes inbox item `lane-resume-adoption-exclusive`. - **F1, exclusive adoption.** `checkpoint.RecordLaneResume` counts the auto-resume and then calls `core.TakeResumeLease` on the workspace of the paused cycle. Both steps run under the same `flock.WithPathLock` that `RecordResume` uses. If a fresh run lease exists, the call refuses with `*core.ResumeHeldError`, which names the holder's run ID, PID and heartbeat. The refusal spends no attempt, and the lane starts a fresh cycle. A spent budget takes no lease. `evolve cycle run` now wires the lane to `RecordLaneResume`. `evolve loop --resume` keeps `RecordResume`. - **F2, the lock decision needs a lane identity.** `RunCycleFromPhase`
